svg.title: Redline Noor sculpt 01
svg.text: Redline: Noor sculpt 01
TA's sf06 (C75, 75 mm) against the design sheet and expression neutral. Cyan = review marks.
TARGET (sheet neutral, 3/4)
REDLINES
Skin far too light and pink. Target #A9714F (warm mid-brown). Check albedo and the R2
exposure.
Eyes read startled: sclera shows all round. Upper lid edge must cover the top ~20% of the
iris at 0.82.
Brows: thin, straight and too high. Groomed arch, thicker inner end, about half an
eye-height lower.
Nose: long tube with a ball tip. Shorter wedge that widens to the nostrils.
Mouth OK. Widen it ~10% and soften the lip outline (no hard rim).
Hair reads as a man's crop. Side parting, swept back over the top of the ears, low bun
visible in 3/4.
Ears too big and too proud. Mostly covered by hair.
Neck too thick and exposed. ~0.5 head-width, blouse collar and blazer lapels framing it.
Blazer reads light grey stone/camouflage. Charcoal #3A3B40 with low dab contrast (about 6%).
Skin dabs blotchy: they read as marks on the skin. Halve the value variation, follow the
stroke map.
What's right: shallow sockets, glossy cornea with the panel row, pale sclera, low bun idea, squared shoulders, brush-dab scale on the face (~5 mm).
